content: Barack Obama, the first African American U.S. president (2009–2017), a Harvard-trained lawyer and former community organizer, spearheaded the Affordable Care Act, championed progressive policies, and embodied pragmatic diplomacy and unity, earning the 2009 Nobel Peace Prize.
